## About

Security at Aurora Solar is a shared responsibility. Everyone at our organization acts as a steward of our company information, data, security practices, and assets. We put a security mindset into everything we build. Our Trust Center focuses on security and privacy standards along with resources, controls, and FAQs to help customers understand how seriously we take security at Aurora Solar.

## Frequently asked

Is Aurora Solar SOC 2 compliant?

Aurora Solar is SOC 2 Type II compliant. On SOC2C this listing is Listed.

Is Aurora Solar PCI DSS compliant?

According to Aurora Solar's public trust center, Aurora Solar is PCI DSS compliant. On SOC2C this listing is Listed.

Is Aurora Solar GDPR compliant?

According to Aurora Solar's public trust center, Aurora Solar is GDPR compliant. On SOC2C this listing is Listed.

Is Aurora Solar SOC 2 Type I or Type II?

Aurora Solar is SOC 2 Type II compliant. A Type II report covers how security controls operated over a period (typically 3 to 12 months), a stronger signal than a point-in-time Type I.

Can I use Aurora Solar's SOC 2 for a vendor risk assessment?

Yes. Aurora Solar's SOC 2 status, frameworks, auditor, and renewal timing are on SOC2C for vendor risk and security reviews. Request the underlying report through SOC2C to complete your third-party risk file.

Is Aurora Solar penetration tested?

Aurora Solar hasn't listed its penetration testing on SOC2C yet. SOC 2 Type II programs typically include periodic third-party penetration tests; the company can add who performed theirs.

Can I get Aurora Solar's SOC 2 report?

Aurora Solar's SOC 2 report is available on request. Request access through SOC2C and we coordinate the company-side NDA and delivery.

Is Aurora Solar secure?

Security isn't a single yes/no, but Aurora Solar is SOC 2 Type II compliant and holds SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, GDPR. SOC2C verifies its compliance posture and shows how strongly each fact is proven.

Does Aurora Solar have a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program?

Aurora Solar hasn't listed a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program on SOC2C. Many companies accept security reports at security@aurorasolar.com or via a /security page (Aurora Solar lists a security contact).

Who are Aurora Solar's subprocessors?

Aurora Solar lists 29 subprocessors on its trust center, including Amplitude , Amazon Web Services, Anthropic, Datadog, DocuSign. Buyers use this for fourth-party risk review.

Where does Aurora Solar host or store data?

Aurora Solar hosts on AWS. Data residency details are on its trust center.

Where is Aurora Solar's trust center or security page?

Aurora Solar's trust center is at https://trust.aurorasolar.com. Its verified SOC 2 status, frameworks, and documents are summarized on its SOC2C profile.

## Answers published by Aurora Solar

Reproduced from Aurora Solar's own trust center. These are the company's statements about its security practices — **SOC2C has not tested or verified them**, and they may have changed since we last read the page. [Check the source ↗](https://trust.aurorasolar.com/)

Is Aurora data encrypted at rest and in transit?

Yes

Are penetration tests performed against the Aurora product?

Yes, Aurora utilizes a third-party security partner to perform penetration tests annually.

Where is customer data stored?

Aurora’s Data is Stored in AWS Data Centers located in the US.

Do we have a Bug Bounty Program?

We do not maintain a reward system for bug bounties but we are always welcoming of reports on bugs that you may have discovered and would like to report.

How do I report an information security issue or concern?

Please reach out to privacy@aurorasolar.com

Do we conduct external testing?

Yes, Aurora Solar conducts annual external network penetration tests, web application assessment tests, cloud security assessment tests, and internal corporate security assessment tests utilizing an external security partner.

Does Aurora Solar have a data subject handling deletion process?

Yes, please reach out to privacy@aurorasolar.com for a request to delete data/information.

Does Aurora Solar's security team hold any certifications?

Yes, Aurora Solar security team members do hold security certification in CISSP and CISM
